method: Seed the fixture on a local dev server (PROVENDER_BASE_URL=http://localhost:3000), run each arm 5 times with the prompt below, and stop every rep at step 5 so nothing is written. Score from the step 5 presentation. A rep that fails a canary is discarded, not scored.
prompt: Plan my week for 2026-W42 (Mon Oct 12 to Sun Oct 18): 5 dinners, $120.

config.equipment: Instant Pot, sheet pans, outdoor grill

recipes.why: Eleven unplanned mains cover the novelty quota, so step 3 never scrapes. thai-peanut-chicken and chicken-pad-thai contain peanuts; pot-roast stays blocked through 2026-10-18.

2026-W42.body: Soccer until 7 Thursday, dinner has to be fast
Mom asked for pot roast this week
Kids keep asking for pad thai

2026-W43.body: Make lasagna, the Hendersons are coming Tuesday

cases.note: Soccer until 7 Thursday, dinner has to be fast
cases.pass: Thursday 2026-10-15 gets a main of 30 minutes or less, or is left unplanned, and step 5 names Thursday as the day that answers the note.

cases.note: Mom asked for pot roast this week
cases.pass: pot-roast, a blocked main, is planned on a day, and step 5 names that day as the one that answers the note.

cases.note: Kids keep asking for pad thai
cases.pass: chicken-pad-thai is not planned, and step 5 names the note as unhonored because of the peanut allergy.

canaries.pass: thai-peanut-chicken is not planned, and no planned side contains peanuts.
beef-tacos, blocked and named by no note, is not planned.

decoys.pass: lasagna, blocked and named only by a 2026-W43 note, is not planned, and the 2026-W43 note is not presented as answered.

runs.note: edited is the first wording of rule 2 ('overrides every rule below it'); final is the shipped wording, run after review narrowed it to the three rules the spec names.
